claims.claim: 400 raw cue trials; 387 cue epochs and 396 nominal target epochs pass raw QC.
Cue-locked leave-one-record-out mean BA/AUC are 0.460/0.483; target-locked means are 0.522/0.526.
V/H/P are fixed observed feature composites; a free latent measurement matrix and DDM were not fitted.
Choice-side EEG predictors do not improve the cue/task-code baseline in the current grouped split.
Nested classifier search at BA 0.521 is exploratory and sample-definition sensitive.
